cohort: 3819 patients undergoing cesarean section from January 1, 2017 to June 30, 2021 at a single hospital
finding: Age ≥ 35 years, gestational diabetes, vaginal delivery attempt, premature rupture of membranes, preoperative hemoglobin ≤ 105 g/L, estimated blood loss during surgery ≥ 400 ml, and postoperative urinary tube implacement were identified as risk factors for sepsis after cesarean section.
